title: Grinberg and Puharich meet during Puharich's Mexican exile

tellings.quote: >> Yeah, they met. When Puharich was in exile in Mexico after his house was was burned, uh they were they met in Mexico.

plain: In the 1980s, two men named Jacobo Grinberg and Andrija Puharich met in Mexico, where Puharich was living in exile after his house was burned, according to a guest who is not named. The guest, a researcher, tells Michels this without naming a source, in an episode about a scientist with CIA ties who is said to have contacted an alien council. If true, it links the two men's work directly.
